To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the market is the main driving force of the higher education development, but the government should play the role of the leader.

the government should play its role in promoting higher education development, but the government should not be the main force of development, and the market should be the major force in promoting the development of institutions of higher education.
the market competition in the era of economic globalisation will bring about the challenge and opportunity for institutions of higher education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to make the government reform and the market competition work together to promote the development of higher education.
the relation among the government,institutions of higher learning and the market.
the relationship of the government,institutions of higher learning and the market in the context of China's entry into WTO.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the market competition of the higher education is the main driving force of the development of higher education, and the government and the institutions should play the role in the process.
we must make the government reform,transform the government function,and promote the development and the competition of the institution of higher learning.
the government should play a role of guidance, the market plays a role of regulation, and the institutions of higher learning should play a role in innovation and competition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the government should take the initiative in the development of the higher education,make it more open and transparent and strengthen the supervision of the market,which will make the higher education more international,industrial, popular and diverse.

we should make the government function more scientific and more effective,improve the government management and service,make the institutions of higher education more competitive and more internationalized.
it is necessary to make a comprehensive and systematic study on the government function,especially on the government reform,so as to promote the development of higher education.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we need to strengthen the management and improve the service quality of the higher education in order to meet the needs of the market and the society.
the government should take the initiative to promote the internationalization of the institutions of higher learning.
we need to strengthen our government reform to meet the challenges and opportunities that the internationalization of the market has brought to higher education.
